cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES5118 from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, now you are ready, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方5118，从武汉飞往北京，现在停在223号停机位，你现在准备好了，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, gate 223, destination Beijing, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，223号停机位，目的地北京，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES5118 standby one, I'll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，稍等，我检查下你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText:
Standby, CES5118.
注：standby指的是“本频道稍等”，可直接回复standby。
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方5118。

cards.audioText: The flight attendant tells you passengers have boarded. All cargo doors are closed. Now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员告诉你，乘客已登机，所有货舱门关闭。现在，报告自己准备好，请求许可
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, we're fully ready, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，我们完全准备好了，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES5118, cleared to Beijing, FL107, runway 18L, ZF11 departure, initially 900m, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，可以飞往北京，高度层107，跑道18左，ZF11离场，初始爬升至900米，离场频率120.6，应答机编码3021。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, FL107, runway 18L, ZF11 departure, initially 900m, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往北京，高度层107，跑道18左，ZF11离场，初始爬升至900米，离场频率120.6，应答机编码3021，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, read back correct, remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118.复诵正确，长守该频率。
cards.referenceText: Roger, monitor, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，守听。东方5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about duration and reason of the delay.
cards.audioTextZh: 5分钟后，放行未呼叫，询问延误持续的时间和原因
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, confirm the duration and reason of the delay?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，证实延误多久，延误的原因是什么？

cards.audioText: CES5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect. Expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于雷暴活动，实施流量管控，飞往同一方向的飞机之间，预计有8分钟的间隔。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, CES5118.
注：题干内容为管制提供的情报（information），无需复诵，可用roger回答。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
[Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanying with thunder and lightning.]
All aircraft on my frequency, airport will be temporarily closed. Thunderstorms on final. Expect delay until the weather improves. Squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
[开始下大雨，伴有打雷和闪电]
我频率上所有的航空器，机场将会暂时关闭。五边上有雷暴。预计延误直到天气变好。若收到此信息，应答机识别。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, squawking ident, CES5118.
注：实际运行中应答机识别只需做动作，无需回复。但在考试中，建议直接像参考答案一样回复管制的指令。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，东方5118。

cards.audioText: One hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open. Now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 一小时后，天气变好，机场开放，现在，询问你的离场顺序
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES5118, you are currently No.1 in your direction. Expect about 20 minutes delay. Contact Ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，你目前是你方向上第一个。预计延误20分钟，联系地面121.8。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 121.8, No.1, CES5118.

cards.audioText: Inform ground you are ready for pushback and start.
cards.audioTextZh: [告知地面，你准备好推出开车了]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing north, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，东方5118。

cards.audioText: You realize the tug is not in position yet. Advise ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 你注意到拖车没有就位。告知地面管制，你需要延误5分钟准备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, tug is not ready, request 5 minutes delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，拖车未就位，请求5分钟延误。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, standby for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，稍等推出，一会呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Standby, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, are you fully ready now? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
[You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay. Advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们10分钟后有一个离场时间。
[由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门，增加乘客餐食和饮料，告知地面，你还需要5分钟来进行配餐]
cards.referenceText: Negative, we need another 5 minutes for catering due long delay, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，由于长时间延误，我们需要5分钟来进行配餐，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，准备好后报。
cards.referenceText:
Wilco, call you back, CES5118.
注意：此处可以说wilco或者call you back。
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，等会呼叫你，东方5118。

cards.audioText: Five minutes later, catering completed, call ready.
cards.audioTextZh: [5分钟之后，配餐完成，呼叫已准备好]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, we are ready, request pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，我们准备好了，请求推出。

cards.audioText: Pushback approved until abeam gate 221. Do not block gate 222, there is incoming traffic to that gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出正切到221号停机位，不要堵塞222号停机位，有架航空器要进入该机位。
cards.referenceText:
Pushback approved until abeam gate 221, not block gate 222, roger, CES5118.
注：此处的推出指令较为复杂，但需要完整复诵，不可用wilco或者roger省略回答。
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出正切到221号停机位，不要堵塞222号停机位，收到，东方5118。

cards.audioText: Engine start completed, now request for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: [发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，经由滑行道M、A，在E1外等待
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道M、A，在E1外等待，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, can you accept E1 intersection for departure? Take off roll is available 3300m.
[Tell tower you can accept.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方5118，你能接受从E1减跑道起飞吗？可用起飞滑跑3300米。
[告诉管制员你可以接受]
cards.referenceText: Affirm, E1 intersection for departure, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意，E1减跑道起飞，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，通过E1上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait via taxiway E1, runway 18L, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过E1上跑道等待，跑道18左，东方5118。

cards.audioText: Report to the tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告给管制员，前面的飞机堵塞了E1滑行道
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5118, an aircraft in front is blocking E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5118，前面的飞机阻塞了E1滑行道。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, roger, Break, break, CSN326, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
[The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，断开，断开，南方326，向前滑行，脱离E1。[飞机移动了，你现在可以继续滑行并上跑道了]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5118, request continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5118，继续滑行，上跑道。

cards.audioText: CES5118. Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，可以起飞，跑道18左，初始保持跑道航向，爬升至1500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, runway heading, climb to 1500m, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，跑道航向，爬升至1500米，东方5118。
